title: Owner-authorized private audio rename PATCH
purpose: Allow the authenticated canonical project owner to rename one private audio asset through a strict same-origin HTTP PATCH backed by audio metadata CAS.
invariants: PATCH body is exactly one field: name.
Audio name is trimmed, non-empty, and at most 120 characters.
Malformed JSON, extra fields, missing name, and non-string name are rejected.
Project and audio route identifiers are parsed canonically.
Owner write authorization occurs before private audio metadata is read or mutated.
The audio asset must belong to the authorized route project.
id, projectId, kind, createdAt, durationSeconds, sampleRateHz, channelCount, contentType, and storageReference remain unchanged.
Metadata update uses the SESH-069A revision CAS.
A stale revision maps to conflict.
Response contains sanitized creator audio metadata only.
storageReference and persistence revision are never returned to the browser.
R2 is never read, written, moved, copied, or deleted.
No public media, download, sharing, collaborator, publishing, master, management, copyright, or royalty authority is introduced.
Studio rename UI is not included in this slice.
